details:
**Q1: What scope should this issue have?**
Choices:
- **A** — One specific workflow or script only (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — One repo area with a few related files
- **C** — Cross-cutting improvement across multiple areas
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: Which area should the change target?**
Choices:
- **A** — Review/autofix and conflict resolution (`workflow-templates/ai-review.yml`, `scripts/review_*`, `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Orchestrator/poller/stall recovery/integration sync (`workflow-templates/ai-orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **C** — Validation/runtime harness/self-heal (`workflow-templates/ai-validate.yml`, `scripts/validate_process.sh`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **D** — Clarify/plan/implement/update-workflows/memory/log-analysis/docs
Note: If you choose `Q1: C`, still pick the primary area here.
Reply: `Q2: A`
**Q3: What should “better” mean for that target?**
Choices:
- **A** — Fix a specific failing issue, PR, workflow run, or flaky behavior; I will identify it in the same reply (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Make one internal reliability/observability improvement with no intended behavior change
- **C** — Make one internal speed/cost improvement with no intended behavior change
- **D** — Make one intentional behavior/feature change; I will summarize the desired behavior in one sentence
Reply: `Q3: A`
